reviews.t: The line used to have a better shampoo (the new formula is not nearly as affective) ...
reviews.x: I’ve used the Fairy Tales Curly Q line for my daughter for about 3-4 years (she is 7yrs old). The line used to have a better shampoo (the new formula is not nearly as affective) & it used to have a gel that was fantastic. This new spray gel is terrible. Since I had to switch to this (bc they no longer make the gel) her hair is frizzy and no longer holding a nice curl. I will never purchase this spray gel again. I actually contacted the company asking them to go back to the gel & original shampoo

claims.text: Many reviewers say it effectively tames frizz and defines curls, turning dry, frizzy hair into soft spirals.
Several reviewers report negative results, including weighed-down, crunchy, sticky curls or massive knots.
Some reviewers raise safety concerns, citing allergic reactions/hives and a strong chemical or alcohol smell.
A few reviewers praise the scent and note it is gentle enough for sensitive users or allergen concerns.
One reviewer complains that the new spray gel formula is worse than the previous gel and shampoo.
